cases.title: An undone demo, redone by the learner, is credited to the learner

rubric.reason: When the turn 4 check showed `demo_credit: learner_after_undo` with `eased_by_learner`, the mentor credited the learner: "You redid the first Position move yourself after undoing my demo, so every ease on Title is your own work"; in turn 3 the same flag came with `still_linear`, and the mentor correctly gave no credit for a pair not yet eased.

When the turn 4 check returned `demo_credit: learner_after_undo` with `eased_by_learner`, the mentor credited the learner: "You eased all four Title pairs yourself... That includes the first move, which you redid after undoing my demo."
